name: @zedec/zxv-react
description: Offline-first React hooks for ZXV (ZxvProvider, useZxv, useGenerate, useBudget, useRational, useLedgerBalance) over an injected backend: z-web in the browser, the @zedec/zxv addon in Node, or the local zxvd JSON-RPC daemon from React Native. Exact numbers, calls queued while offline and replayed in order, ledger posts never duplicated.
author: Michael Laurence Curzi and 36N9 Genetics, LLC

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/rational.test.js dist/test/client.test.js dist/test/hooks.test.js dist/test/zxvd.test.js dist/test/sdk.test.js dist/test/zweb.test.js
